<p class="phs-research-intro">My research spans global health, mental health, and developmental science, drawing on epidemiology, psychology, and quantitative methods to understand health and well-being across populations and the life course.</p>

<script>
/* Research area highlighting — scoped only to this page.
   Unrelated papers remain visible but muted, as requested. */
(function () {
  function initResearchFilters() {
    const root = document.querySelector('.phs-research-page');
    if (!root) return;
    const controls = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('button[data-filter]'));
    const papers = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.phs-publication[data-area]'));
    const status = root.querySelector('#phs-filter-status');
    const labels = {
      global: 'Global Health & Disease Burden',
      mental: 'Mental Health & Well-being',
      development: 'Developmental & Behavioral Science'
    };
    function selectArea(area) {
      controls.forEach(btn => btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(btn.dataset.filter === area)));
      let matched = 0;
      papers.forEach(paper => {
        const isMatch = area === 'all' || paper.dataset.area.split(/\s+/).includes(area);
        if (isMatch) matched += 1;
        paper.classList.toggle('is-muted', !isMatch);
        paper.classList.toggle('is-matched', area !== 'all' && isMatch);
      });
      if (status) status.textContent = area === 'all'
        ? ''
        : 'Highlighting ' + matched + ' publication records in ' + labels[area] + '. Other papers remain visible in a lighter shade.';
    }
    controls.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => selectArea(btn.dataset.filter)));
    selectArea('all');
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initResearchFilters);
  } else {
    initResearchFilters();
  }
})();
</script>
